column1: # catalog/pr-self-check.d/ — more rows for the pre-review self-check. Each file
# is one ticket's rows; bin/lib/pr-self-check.sh reads them after
# catalog/pr-self-check.tsv, in C filename order. The columns and the triggers
# are in that file's header. Add a new file here; never append to the main file.
# This file (BH-6380, BH-6372.2): a perf/cost PR must carry an "Outcome replay"
# section with a target line and a measured number.
#   param `perf`: the linked ticket is perf/cost by pt_classify
#   match `under=<heading-ERE>>><line-ERE>`: a line under that heading matches;
#     `&` ANDs the two terms. The target term follows pt_parse_target's grammar,
#     with one known gap: under= matches without case (grep -i), and the parser
#     needs `Target metric:` and a lower-case id. So `target metric: MQ from 1
#     to 2` passes this row, and pt_parse_target cannot read it.

column4: an "Outcome replay" section with a target and a measured number
